Technical focus

Four disciplines. One workbench.

Embedded Systems

Bring firmware, sensors and wireless links together in working hardware.

VLSI

Device Modelling

UAVs

About the chapter

From the classroom
to the workbench

We’re a community of student engineers, researchers and builders. Through peer-led bootcamps, hardware experiments and technical mentorship, we make circuits and systems accessible to students who want to build.

Our mission is to foster innovation and excellence in circuits and systems for the benefit of humanity. We share the Society’s commitment to scientific excellence, integrity, education and inclusive leadership.

Chapter project

Temper-Link

Temper-Link is an in-house prototype that combines temperature sensing with a custom antenna designed by the team.

Team Link-it-up placed 10th globally in Phase 2 of the IEEE HART HardwAIre Challenge.

Explore Temper-Link

Explore IEEE

The Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE) connects students and engineers through technical communities, publications, conferences, and standards.

IEEE JUSB is the campus-wide Student Branch at Jadavpur University. Our IEEE CASS chapter brings together students interested in the design and analysis of circuits and systems.
